transport: optional WebSocket text frames beside an unchanged Everglade session
semantics: The client explicitly opts in. Unknown @1 frames are ignored by existing sessions. No gameplay message changes.
An i request precedes the unchanged I input. Only an actual newly accepted input and that exact successfully stepped sequence qualify.
A d report follows a complete D whose ack covers the sampled input and whose bytes were accepted by the socket output queue.
Queue acceptance is neither kernel delivery nor client presentation. Failed or missing samples remain missing.
The client records WebSocket receipt, application delivery, render submission and GPU completion separately; GPU completion is not physical display scanout.

Clock offset lies in [server_encode-client_receive, server_receive-client_send] under nonnegative transport and a constant-offset clock model. Quantization and declared drift allowances expand this interval.
Telemetry refusal, timeout, saturation and retirement cannot admit, reject, delay or mutate gameplay. No telemetry retry queue exists.
